cost: O(label bytes + queried rows + output TSV bytes) expected work/memory, plus SQL. Each input ID is scanned for duplicates and missing/ambiguous membership; diagnostic output limits displayed IDs to five but counts all.
description: Pragmatic label parser and staged load
forward: read_labels accepts exact first eight header columns plus optional trace, skips empty lines and requires row width. Missing trace becomes empty. load rejects empty/duplicate sent_id, stages wanted IDs, queries maxima/runs/sentences, rejects duplicate run then missing then ambiguous IDs. It writes run/annset/pragmatics rows, validates bits, maps empty means/trace to NULL, executes SQL and checks post row count.
inverse: Foreign header, wrong width, no rows or duplicate IDs cannot reach write exec. Invalid bit cannot yield a successful load; it may have already written temporary rows. A post-count error does not exclude a committed DB state.

Given stored pragmatic row, compatible TSVs may omit trace or supply empty trace, and use either 1/true or 0/false. Empty means and trace collapse to NULL; lexical bool spelling is unrecoverable. Unused source/database fields remain unconstrained.

Eight columns append one empty trace field; nine require trace as final header. Header-only parser output is empty but load subsequently rejects. Empty lines are skipped, whitespace-only lines are not.
bit maps exactly {0,false}->false and {1,true}->true, excluding yes, case changes, negatives and empty. The direct helper check exercises these finite cases.
Missing IDs are reported before ambiguous IDs after duplicate run rejection. Exactly one (sid,doc) is required; identical duplicate candidates still count as ambiguity.
migrate_sql returns a borrowed suffix beginning at the first literal -- migrate:v substring. It neither parses SQL nor checks migration idempotence; actual DDL semantics remain unexecuted.
limitations: Finite helper/fixture evidence only; no DuckDB integration or SQL semantics
Partial syntax projection; no macro expansion or full semantic proof
No executable approximate profile or speedup claim
state: Each admitted label maps to exactly one prior sentence/doc and one new aid on the safe nonoverflow domain. Source does not validate closed form/act sets. IDs are max+1 increments; bits accept only 0,false,1,true with exact spelling.
